cases.sentence: В эти дни, когда число учеников стало расти, грекоязычные евреи начали жаловаться на местных ___.
cases.translation: In those days, when the number of disciples was multiplying, the Hellenistic Jews began to complain against the Hebrew Jews.
cases.explain: The preposition на (against) with accusative indicates direction, but жаловаться на takes accusative; here with евреев it's the direct object.

cases.sentence: Мы не можем, оставив служение ___, заняться обслуживанием столов.
cases.translation: We cannot abandon the ministry of the Word and serve tables.
cases.explain: The possessive genitive case shows that this is the Word's ministry — 'служение Слова' means 'ministry of the Word'.

cases.sentence: Выберите из вашей среды семь человек с хорошей репутацией, исполненных духа и мудрости, и мы возложим на них эту ___.
cases.translation: Select from among you seven men of good repute, full of the Spirit and of wisdom, and we will appoint them to this service.
cases.explain: The direct object of the verb возложим (we will place/assign) takes the accusative case, which for neuter nouns equals the nominative.

cases.sentence: Это предложение всем понравилось, и выбрали Стефана, человека полного веры и святого ___.
cases.translation: This proposal pleased them all. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit.
cases.explain: The adjective полного (full) governs the genitive case when expressing what something is full of.

cases.sentence: Их представили апостолам, и те помолились и возложили на них ___.
cases.translation: They set them before the apostles, and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
cases.explain: The verb возложили (they laid) takes the accusative case for its direct object — the hands.

cases.sentence: Стефан, человек полный Божьей благодати и силы, совершал в народе великие чудеса и ___.
cases.translation: Stephen, a man full of God's grace and power, was performing great wonders and signs among the people.
cases.explain: In the construction 'чудеса и знамения', the genitive plural form is used in the parallel structure of counting objects.

cases.translation: They entered into a dispute with Stephen.
cases.explain: The preposition со (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Представили лжесвидетелей, которые сказали, что этот человек постоянно говорит против святого ___ и против закона.
cases.translation: They brought in false witnesses who said that this man constantly speaks against the holy temple and against the law.
cases.explain: The preposition против (against) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Мы не можем, оставив служение Словом Божьим, заняться обслуживанием столов.
reading.question: What did the apostles say they could not do?
options: Abandon the ministry of the Word to serve tables
reading.correct: Abandon the ministry of the Word to serve tables
reading.explain: The apostles said they could not abandon the ministry of the Word to serve tables (обслуживанием столов).

reading.ru: Выберите из вашей среды семь человек с хорошей репутацией, исполненных духа и мудрости.
reading.question: What qualities should the seven men have?
options: Good reputation, full of the Spirit and wisdom
reading.correct: Good reputation, full of the Spirit and wisdom
reading.explain: The apostles asked for men with good reputation (хорошей репутацией), full of the Spirit (духа) and wisdom (мудрости).

reading.ru: Выбрали Стефана, человека полного веры и святого духа, Филиппа, Прохора, Никанора, Тимона, Пармена и Николая из Антиохии.
reading.question: How many men were chosen, and who was one of them?
options: Seven men, one of whom was Stephen
reading.correct: Seven men, one of whom was Stephen
reading.explain: The text lists seven men: Stephen, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus.

reading.ru: Их представили апостолам, и те помолились и возложили на них руки.
reading.question: What did the apostles do when the seven were presented to them?
options: They prayed and laid their hands on them
They sent them to different cities
They gave them money for the poor
reading.correct: They prayed and laid their hands on them
reading.explain: The apostles помолились (prayed) and возложили на них руки (laid their hands on them) in blessing.

reading.ru: Слово Божие распространялось, и число учеников в Иерусалиме быстро увеличивалось, даже многие священники покорились вере.
reading.question: What happened to the number of disciples in Jerusalem?
options: It increased rapidly, and even many priests believed
It grew only among Hellenistic Jews
reading.correct: It increased rapidly, and even many priests believed
reading.explain: The text says число учеников быстро увеличивалось (increased rapidly) and многие священники покорились вере (many priests were obedient to the faith).

reading.ru: Все сидевшие в высшем совете внимательно смотрели на Стефана и видели, что лицо его, как лицо ангела.
reading.question: What did the members of the council see when they looked at Stephen?
options: His face was like the face of an angel
reading.correct: His face was like the face of an angel
reading.explain: The text directly states that they saw that его лицо было как лицо ангела (his face was like the face of an angel).
